v2_requalification_reason: V2 demonstrated that a head-space epsilon derived only from binary64 spacing in h is not a valid endpoint contract for the composed S->h inverse. For O01 and O05, exact frozen S_max values round-trip through h(S) to approximately 2.79e-13 and 9.13e-13 cm wetter than h=-1 cm, respectively, while the V2 head tolerance at that boundary is approximately 2.84e-14 cm. This is conditioning of the constitutive inverse at the wet endpoint, not physical extrapolation.
purpose: Qualify a bounded dense-table refinement without allowing a numerical endpoint guard to create false domain failures or silently extend the physical head envelope.

unchanged_physical_face_law.constitutive_family: unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten using KSATFIT with KSATEXM disabled

candidate_representation.interpolation_arithmetic: four float32 nodal log-mobility values converted to float64; bilinear interpolation and exp evaluated in float64
candidate_representation.axis_storage: analytic uniform log-head axis; no axis array
candidate_representation.candidate_selection: smallest N passing every frozen criterion on every stress material
candidate_representation.shared_memory_formula_bytes: 4*N*N + 32 bytes fixed scalar metadata upper bound

state_space_endpoint_contract.authoritative_state_domain: [S_min,S_max] where S_min=S(h=-10000 cm) and S_max=S(h=-1 cm) are computed from the same immutable material parameters used by the face table
state_space_endpoint_contract.outside_state_policy: reject if S lies outside [S_min,S_max] by more than the state-boundary tolerance; otherwise clamp only to that exact state boundary
state_space_endpoint_contract.exact_boundary_inverse: after the allowed state-space clamp, S==S_min maps directly to h=-10000 cm and S==S_max maps directly to h=-1 cm without evaluating the constitutive inverse h(S)
state_space_endpoint_contract.interior_inverse: for S strictly inside (S_min,S_max), evaluate the frozen constitutive h(S) and require the result to lie inside the exact frozen head envelope; no head-space domain-extension epsilon is allowed
state_space_endpoint_contract.endpoint_coordinate: the exact mapped wet and dry head boundaries use u=0 and u=4 respectively
state_space_endpoint_contract.rationale: Endpoint identity belongs to the state-to-coordinate map. It must not depend on the conditioning error of composing the floating retention forward and inverse functions.

fresh_characterization.note: These are characterization probes already exposed during C1R design and may never be reused as the later catalog holdout.

exit_rule.characterization_pass: freeze the smallest passing N and this exact float32/state-space endpoint representation before generating any fresh 36-material holdout
exit_rule.characterization_fail: reject bounded dense bilinear refinement fail-closed and investigate a different interpolation representation rather than tuning a future holdout

scope_guard: No KSATEXM, other hydraulic families, saturation switching, heterogeneous profiles, timestep accuracy, processes, bottom boundaries, groundwater, MultiSWAP, real-table response tangents or FullRichards equivalence.
